reels.title: Amazon could spend nearly $500 billion a year on AI: JPMorgan
reels.summary:
JPMorgan expects Amazon to pour $395 billion into capital expenditures in 2027, up 77% from this year’s estimated $220 billion, before climbing to $476 billion in 2028 as its AI buildout picks up.
